title: CERN Summer Student Programme 2027 (Member and Non-Member State)
about: CERN invites Bachelor's and Master's students of all nationalities to apply for its 2027 Summer Student Programme, an onsite placement in Geneva. Nationals of Canada, Japan and the US apply through separate national portals.
requirements: Bachelor's or Master's student (PhD candidates not eligible)
At least 6 semesters of full-time university study

upskill.name: AI Foundations Academy
why: Field "Physics, computing and engineering" → AI Foundations Academy course Machine Learning - Foundations & Methods I: "Supervised learning: classification, regression, decision trees, SVMs, ensemble methods" (closest Academy page; no course reaches the minimum match score, so the link goes to the Academy page)
